name: InterContinental Changsha
positioning: Riverside hotel in Changsha's Beichen Delta, where the Xiang and Liuyang rivers meet, with a cruiser-style facade, a 27-metre atrium, Xiangjiang River-view rooms, a heated indoor pool with a sky view and the SKY27 rooftop bar
best_for: Travelers who want river views over the Xiangjiang in central Changsha
Guests who like striking architecture and a rooftop bar above the city
City travelers who want a metro link to Wuyi Square and culture within walking distance

facts.text: The hotel sits in the Beichen Delta of Kaifu District, where the Xiang River and Liuyang River converge.
The hotel is four metro stops from Wuyi Square, the city's commercial heart.
The Three Halls and One Center cultural complex and the Beichen Hui commercial hub are within walking distance.
The hotel has a cruiser-style facade and a 27-metre-high atrium, combining international design with the cultural heritage of Hunan.
Rooms are contemporary in design and styled with local cultural flair.
Each room has a marble bathtub and a separate walk-in rainforest shower.
The fitness center has a heated indoor swimming pool with a sky view.
The hotel's spa, Abel Touch SPA, has a sauna and steam bathing.
Zhi Wei Xuan Chinese Restaurant serves Cantonese and Hunan fusion cuisine with sweeping views of the Xiangjiang River.
SKY27, the rooftop bar on the 27th floor, has a panoramic view of the Xiangjiang River and the city skyline.
The hotel is close to Changsha Binjiang Cultural Park, Changsha Museum and Joy City.

highlights.text: The hotel sits where the Xiang River and Liuyang River converge, in the Beichen Delta of Kaifu District.
A cruiser-style facade and a 27-metre-high atrium blend international design with the cultural heritage of Hunan.
SKY27, the rooftop bar on the 27th floor, looks out over the Xiangjiang River and the city skyline.
Guest rooms offer views of the Xiangjiang River, with a marble bathtub and a separate walk-in rainforest shower.
The fitness center has a heated indoor swimming pool with a sky view.

considerations.text: Changsha Huanghua International Airport is about 32 kilometers from the hotel.
Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
